body_markdown:
# Join the Uberduck Referral Program


Earn money when you refer people to Uberduck's paid plans.


Public service announcement: Uberduck has a referral program now. If you participate, you can earn money every time someone signs up for one of our paid plans.


You can sign up for the referral program[here](https://uberduck.getrewardful.com/signup) .


Once you sign up, you'll get a special URL that you can share with others. When someone signs up for a premium plan after finding Uberduck through your URL, our referral system will register the premium signup and you'll get paid!


Sign up today, and thanks for helping us grow Uberduck 😎.
